description: A white T‑shirt lies on a yellow tabletop in front of a red cloth backdrop. The left hand reaches forward to grab and lift the shirt while the right hand joins to make it a two-hand object, stretching it open and laying it flat; then the left hand folds one side inward, folds it again into a longer rectangle, and finishes by bringing part of the shirt over into a compact basic fold while the right hand steadies the fabric before letting go.
